Title: Die Indices librorum prohibitorum des sechzehnten Jahrhunderts
Creator: Franz Heinrich Reusch (editor); the sixteenth-century index texts he prints, including the Index of Paul IV (1559) and the Tridentine Index of Pius IV (1564)
Publisher: Tübingen: Litterarischer Verein in Stuttgart (Bibliothek des Litterarischen Vereins in Stuttgart, CLXXVI), 1886
Publication Date: 1886
Rights: Public Domain (published 1886; the host also carries a Public Domain Mark 1.0)
Language: deu (mixed: Reusch's German introduction and notes, with the index texts and book titles in their original Latin, and Dutch and Spanish book titles)
Source: Internet Archive item bub_gb_W6wLAAAAIAAJ (Google scan listed as a microform copy; contributor "unknown library"), file bub_gb_W6wLAAAAIAAJ_djvu.txt, fetched directly by the library/source-research thread (Era VII session), 2026-10-16; host rights statement: licenseurl http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/ (Public Domain Mark 1.0).
Provenance note: Header prepended; the OCR text follows unchanged, no long-s characters present (0 replaced). Rights basis in one checkable sentence: the preface in the OCR is dated "Tübingen, den 9 Februar 1886" (the title-page year is garbled in the OCR), so the book was published in 1886, before the 1930 cutoff of the project's rolling 95-year rule.
Content note: A scholar's edition, not a papal act: Reusch's introduction and notes are scholarship (context); the sixteenth-century index texts he prints are the primary text. His table of contents (file lines near 39740) lists the sections, among them "13. Index Pauls IV von 1559 ... 176" and "15. Index Pius IV von 1564 (der sogenannte Trienter index) ... 243", with the Liège index of 1569 at page 282 and the Antwerp index of 1570 at page 289. The OCR is Antiqua with scattered recognition errors, heavier in the Dutch and Spanish passages; sampled at five points (10/30/50/70/90 percent): noisy but legible at each. Whole-file share of word-shaped tokens: 0.82. Reusch's Latin index texts are the evidence; treat the OCR as a second witness for exact wording until checked on the page images. The catalogue entry for the other copy of this book (dieindiceslibro00reusgoog) gives the date 1961, which is a reprint date and not this edition's; this file is the 1886 edition. No public-domain English translation was found.
